scope: The context after each handler, at the next dispatch boundary. The native layout is TH12's own, so the mapping from its slots to port offsets is derived from the cases, not declared. No renderer and no complete-game equivalence is claimed.
nativeCoverage: every real handler of the flat table

measuredConstants.loopRelation: the dispatch guard minus 0x17, and the TH13 oracle uses the same relation
measuredConstants.callConvention: the VM in EDI, the script pointer at [edi+0x3f0], the script in ESI
measuredConstants.coverage: every real handler of the flat table

derivedArrangement.reading: a bit is settled when one port channel bit reproduces its change in every case of the opcode that writes it, or when a pair of bits does; it is credible when the source bit is not also claimed by another native bit of that opcode

summary.reading: a native bit is matched when one port bit changes in exactly the cases it does; the source bit need not be the same bit of the same field

positionClaim: the position is the port's delta for every opcode that falls through; the pointer-install class above is excluded and counted
